problems.quote: The traditional "iron rice bowl" (lifetime security) was replaced by flexible workforce models

problems.verifierReason: Iron rice bowl is a Chinese term; not a general descriptor of bureaucracy.

problems.quote: The "Administrative Man" was replaced by the "Social Man."
problems.problem: Historical sequence is reversed. The Human Relations era (1930s) introduced "Social Man" (Mayo) to replace "Economic Man" (Taylor). Simon's "Administrative Man" appeared later (1947).
problems.correction: The "Economic Man" was replaced by the "Social Man."
problems.verifierReason: Historical sequence: Economic Man (Taylor) -> Social Man (Mayo) -> Administrative Man (Simon).

problems.quote: The 2013 amendment mandating social audits by Gram Sabhas
